### The More Excellent Way of Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-more-excellent-way-of-love
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:31
Points:
- Division and rivalry over spiritual gifts troubled the Corinthian church much like today.
- Paul prepares believers for 1 Corinthians 13 by pointing them to a better path than competitive gifting.
- Unlike individual spiritual gifts distributed variously, love is a universal way all Christians must walk.
- Exercising any spiritual gift without love results in spiritual failure and immaturity.
- Believers must follow God's definition of love rather than the world's distorted ideas of it.

### The Body of Christ Needs You
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/the-body-of-christ-needs-you-daily-hope-with-rick-warren-march-26-2019.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:27
Points:
- Believers need connection to a local church family to practically serve others.
- Every member has an essential role, and no form of service is insignificant to God.
- Small and behind-the-scenes ministries often make the greatest practical difference.
- Just as an unhealthy bodily organ harms the entire physical body, disengaged Christians weaken the church.
- Using your gifts to serve fellow believers is direct service to God Himself.
